card.summary: 200,000 characters per entry (hard, enforced at API), unlimited entries, no account required. Entries kept 'forever' unless they break rules.

free_tier.stated: 200,000 characters per entry (hard, enforced at API), unlimited entries, no account required. Entries kept 'forever' unless they break rules.

retention.stated: Entries are kept forever unless they break the rules, in which case they might be deleted, or the owner deletes them.

egress.terms: free direct GET, no metering; behind Cloudflare so it is CDN-cacheable at the edge.

record.tooling: Official Python client github.com/radude/rentry (593 stars) + pip package 'rentry'; single-file CLI with zero dependencies.
record.chaining: Unlimited anonymous entries x 200,000 chars (~150 KB of base64 binary after the 4/3 encoder penalty). To reach 500 GB you would need ~3.5M entries, so this is a control-plane / manifest store, not a data tier. Unless an unlimited free identity source is added, and even then the operator's storage is the ceiling.

limits.value: roughly 10 anonymous creations per minute per IP (429 status when exceeded)
Application and stated in the 400 error, so silent truncation does not happen. Writes fail.

record.limits_note: 200,000 chars per entry; custom URL 2-100 chars; edit_code required to modify; no per-account quota and no per-IP cap observed (8 rapid anonymous POSTs all returned 200); URL squatting reclaimed after 12 months idle.
record.reliability_note: Anonymous creation is limited per IP to roughly 10 per minute (429); the per-entry text ceiling is enforced by the application and a write above it fails with a 400. Bulk write volume at the creation limit is the untested risk.
record.confidence_note: pages captured 2026-11-03: https://github.com/radude/rentry, https://rentry.co/what, https://rentry.co/user-account/membership; the per-IP creation limit rests on a third-party client README, so the rung stays reported
